thread:
ana: Heads-up — intermittent SSE parse failures reported from iOS Safari when users background the app and then reopen quickly. Seeing `Unexpected token` after reconnect.
peter: which sample / SDK? any repro steps?
ana: sample-mobile (webview) using browser-sdk@2.0.6. Steps: start a streaming completion, background the tab around chunk 4, then foreground and immediately reconnect. Happens ~4% of trials on real devices.
dina: could be proxy or platform mangling newlines or dropping an LF when socket closes. do we have raw frames?
ana: pasted sanitized raw bytes we capture via SDK debug (SDK_DEBUG_SSE=raw):
```
data: {"chunk":1,"t":"hi"}


data: {"chunk":2,"t":"more"}


data: {"chunk":3,"t":"even"}


data: {"chunk":4,"t":"last"}


<background/tab-suspend here>
[after reconnect we sometimes see:]
data: {"chunk":5,"t":"next"}


data: {"chunk":4,"t":"last"}


OR glued frames like:
data: {"chunk":4,"t":"last"}
data: {"chunk":5,"t":"next"}

```
proxy-bot: Observed similar patterns — corporate proxy (tcp-optimizer v1.2) coalesces CRLFs when a client suspends/resumes. Also had a bug where it strips a trailing LF on socket teardown.
peter: ok two issues: (A) missing/truncated newline leads to glued `data:` headers -> parse error, (B) the client sometimes retries immediately and triggers an auth refresh mid-handshake so the reconnect goes out with an expired token and the server returns 401 which we then surface as a parse error in logs.
dina: mitigation suggestions: 1) parser resilience — normalize newlines (CRLF->LF), accept single-LF separators, and on parse-error attempt a `
?data:` fallback split before failing; 2) maintain a short-lived partial buffer across abort+reconnect so we don't lose an unfinished JSON piece; 3) dedupe by explicit `chunk` id for a rolling window to handle duplicates or reorders; 4) add a tiny reconnect jitter (50-200ms) on mobile to let platform sockets drain; 5) ensure auth refresh completes before retrying (block reconnect until token promise resolves).
ana: implemented a quick local patch in browser-sdk: normalize newlines, stash partial buffer keyed by client-id for 500ms, and block reconnect until auth refresh resolves (we now await token refresh promise in reconnect path). On device tests (iPhone 12 / iOS 16) that reduced failures from 4% -> 0.3% over 500 cycles.
peter: nice. please open a PR with unit tests that simulate: background+resume (simulate socket tear), auth-refresh race (token rejected then renewed), and glued frames. Also add an e2e test for our mobile sample using puppeteer + real-device infra if possible.
ci-bot: nightly-mobile job queued for branch peter/sse-mobile-resume-fix  build #1187 queued.
proxy-bot: noted — ops will patch tcp-optimizer to stop stripping final LF in next release, but clients must remain resilient. We'll file internal ticket OPS-7123.
dina: for immediate release plan: cut browser-sdk@2.0.9 patch with the parser+auth-wait fixes, and bump mobile sample. Add changelog: "Fix: SSE resilience for mobile background/resume; normalize line endings; await auth refresh before reconnect; small reconnect jitter."
ana: added README troubleshooting: enable `SDK_DEBUG_SSE=raw`, collect raw frames, and include token refresh logs when filing. Also recommended: on fragile mobile networks enable 150ms default reconnect jitter.
peter: add release note and include a short migration note: older SDKs may throw `Unexpected token` — upgrade to >=2.0.9.
ci-bot: build #1187 running tests.
ana: final status: after PR merged and patch release rolled out, mobile 1000-cycle background/resume test on device farm showed 0 failures. leaving note here for folks hitting similar issues. last run: 2315003590 (reacted :raised_hands:).
